qs.q: A child with a developmental quotient (DQ) of 65 is evaluated by a specialist. What does this score suggest?
qs.e: A DQ below 70 suggests a developmental delay. The DQ is calculated as developmental age divided by chronological age multiplied by 100.
qs.s: Normal Development: Milestones from Birth to Five Years: MCQs
